releases.name: Experimental Tauri Companion v0.1.2
releases.body:
Tauri Companion now remembers the last window position and docked edge for each project, restoring them before the window appears. This fixes placement resets and jumping near the bottom-right corner.

## Fixed

- Keep the configured corner's work-area margin when the agent grid changes size. Custom floating windows keep their top-left position.
- Restore docked windows as collapsed handles, and keep saved positions visible after display or work-area changes.
- Identify projects by their canonical full paths so directories with the same name keep separate positions.
- Prevent queued geometry updates from interrupting a drag, and finish queued placement saves when the owning session exits.

Placement is stored in `companion-tauri-positions.json` beside the plugin state file, honoring `XDG_DATA_HOME`. Existing coordinates for the same full project path are used when no Tauri placement has been saved.

## Install on macOS Apple silicon

Download `mechanicus-companion-tauri-v0.1.2-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` and `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Verify the archive with `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt`, extract it, and set `companion.binaryPath` to the executable's absolute path. Restart OpenCode to load it.

This experimental build is ad hoc signed and is not notarized. Custom `binaryPath` installations require manual replacement when updating. This release includes only the macOS Apple silicon executable.

## Validation

- 87 Rust tests and 3,643 Bun tests passed.
- Formatting, type checks, and release builds passed.
- The executable extracted from the release archive passed 18 native macOS scenarios, including placement after restart, dock restoration, grid resizing, and owner-exit persistence.
- Code signature and archive SHA-256 verified. Native testing used one display; negative coordinates and display boundaries are also covered by Rust tests.

releases.name: Experimental Tauri Companion v0.1.1
releases.body:
# Experimental Tauri Companion v0.1.1

The project name now appears in a black speech bubble when hovering an icon. The bubble includes a tail, wraps long names, and moves to stay visible near screen edges. Brighter status rings distinguish running (solid green) from waiting for input (dashed amber), including on the collapsed handle.

## macOS Apple silicon

Download `mechanicus-companion-tauri-v0.1.1-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` and verify it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Extract the executable and set `companion.binaryPath` in your mechanicus configuration to its absolute path. Restart OpenCode to use it.

This build is experimental, ad hoc signed, and not notarized. The existing Companion installer and updater continue to use the separate egui implementation and do not update custom `binaryPath` executables. Other platforms are not included in this release.

releases.name: mechanicus v0.9.2
releases.body:
# mechanicus v0.9.2

This release brings the latest OpenCode integration updates and an experimental Tauri Companion with improved project and status indicators.

## Added

- Preset inheritance and session-scoped preset binding for capable OpenCode v2 hosts.
- Three bundled skills: `step-back`, `deanchor`, and `ai-estimates`.
- Read-only diagnostics for failed, cancelled, and stopped background tasks.

## Changed and fixed

- Improved OpenCode v2 task completion, fallback, session identity, and prompt-cache handling.
- Improved preset editing, patch recovery, and webfetch handling.
- The v2 server bundle resolves the supported Zod dependency even when the build environment has an older nested copy.
- The experimental Tauri Companion shows project names in a black speech bubble on hover, wraps long names, and keeps the bubble visible at screen edges. Brighter, distinct green and dashed amber status indicators remain visible when docked.

## Compatibility

- The automatic Companion installer continues to use the existing egui Companion. The experimental Tauri build is available separately for macOS Apple silicon from [Tauri Companion v0.1.1](https://github.com/shyrz/mechanicus/releases/tag/companion-tauri-v0.1.1); configure its executable with `companion.binaryPath`.
- OpenCode v2 `task_revive` has a known limitation: a host lacking `client.session.status` can leave the revived task's terminal state uncertain.
- npm publication of `mechanicus@0.9.2` is pending registry authentication; the current npm `latest` remains `0.9.1`.

# mechanicus v0.9.1

Patch release fixing the Tauri companion remaining alive after its owning TUI or desktop host exits.

## Fixed

- The companion now exits when its owning session disappears or when the host PID recorded in that session is no longer running.
- Unix host liveness checks distinguish an unreaped zombie process from a live host, preventing an abrupt shutdown from leaving a detached companion behind.
- `CompanionManager` now kills only the companion PID it spawned when its PID file is still current, avoiding termination of a replacement companion instance.

## Compatibility

- No configuration migration is required.
- npm package: [`mechanicus@0.9.1`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mechanicus/v/0.9.1)

# mechanicus v0.9.0

First release under the `mechanicus` name — the renamed continuation of
`oh-my-opencode-slim`. Same plugin, new name: package, CLI, config file, skill
namespace, and agent names.

## Added

- **Tauri companion (experimental)** — `companion-tauri/`, a successor to the
  egui companion: per-agent tiles drawn with Nucleo `sharp` icons, fixed-position
  snapping (left / right / bottom), a docked handle carrying the session status,
  drag gestures with a landing preview, and click-to-reveal for the session being
  shown.
- **Companion release assets** — `companion-v0.9.0` ships the macOS arm64
  archive; the installer and updater verify downloads against the SHA256 manifest
  shipped with the plugin.

## Changed

- Package, CLI binary, log and state paths, TUI badge, and config file move to
  `mechanicus`: `~/.config/opencode/mechanicus.json` (or `.jsonc`), with project
  config at `.opencode/mechanicus.json`.
- Built-in agents renamed; the previous names still resolve through aliases:

  | previous | now |
  | --- | --- |
  | `orchestrator` | `omnissiah` |
  | `explorer` / `explore` | `magos` |
  | `librarian` | `logis` |
  | `oracle` | `dominus` |
  | `designer` / `frontend-ui-ux-engineer` | `artisan` |
  | `fixer` | `genetor` |

## Migration notes

- The plugin reads `mechanicus.json` only; an existing `oh-my-opencode-slim.json`
  is ignored. Rename the file and point its `$schema` at
  `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyrz/mechanicus/master/mechanicus.schema.json`.
- Update the plugin entry: `plugin: ["oh-my-opencode-slim"]` becomes
  `plugin: ["mechanicus"]`, or a path to a local checkout.
- Agent overrides keyed by a previous name keep working (`agents.oracle` and
  friends need no edit), so an existing config only needs the rename above.

## Publish notes

- First publish of the `mechanicus` npm package (`0.9.0`).
- Companion assets ship for macOS arm64 only in this release; other targets
  follow when they are built.
